note: Versioned DOM selector registry consumed by GET /api/selectors (tools/ncm_host.mjs) and merged by loader/framework.js in the order SELECTOR_FALLBACK > builds.default > builds[<client version>]. The client's front-end bundle (web.pack) carries CSS-module hashes that change between packs, so a selector fix is a change to this file, not to code.
provenance: Reconstructed 2026-10 from the SELECTOR_FALLBACK table inside loader/framework.js, which was itself recorded against web.pack 477f8a2. Entries marked with an empty string are KNOWN DEAD in 3.1.41: keeping the key means a miss is reported to <data>/selector-discovery.json instead of being silently swallowed. No value here is a new claim.
